verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own docs say it has deployment environments with centralized visibility, environment-level permissions, and change-management and approval workflows. However, approvals are tied to the Jira Service Management integration, and tracking which change is deployed to which environment is only implied by mapping incidents to deployments. Missing for 10: explicit approval-gate configuration per environment within Bitbucket itself, documented per-environment deployment history showing which commit or change is live where, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can define deployment environments with approval gates and track which change is deployed where

citations.quote: centralized visibility across pipeline status, testing policies, deployment environments and more
define granular branch‑level, environment‑level, and package permissions
Enable automated change approval processes and resolve incidents faster by mapping incidents to deployments with Bitbucket and Jira Service Management.
